claim: learner runs non-root with an empty capability set (effective, permitted AND bounding), no_new_privs, seccomp filter
expected: uid=10002 CapEff=0 CapBnd=0 NoNewPrivs=1 Seccomp=2

claim: the only writable path is /work (16 MiB tmpfs); rootfs, /tmp, /etc, /opt and /dev/shm are read-only
expected: writable: /work only; every other probed path EROFS

claim: no application environment leaks into the sandbox
expected: environ keys subset of {PATH, LANG}

claim: no host container-engine socket and no host bind mount is visible (TM-013)
expected: no docker/podman/containerd/crio socket path exists; no mount under /home,/run/user,/var/run,...

claim: no network: only loopback, no route; TCP/UDP/DNS/abstract-unix/raw to dummy host listeners and public IPs all fail
expected: interfaces=['lo'], routes=0, zero host listener hits, raw socket EPERM

claim: PID cap 64 (cgroup pids.max): bounded fork loop stops with EAGAIN near the cap; kernel counts the hits
expected: fork.error=EAGAIN, children in [55,63], pids.events max >= 1, pids.max=64

claim: memory cap 256 MiB (no swap): allocator is OOM-killed, supervisor survives and reports
expected: learner exit -9, never reaches 'survived', oom_kill>=1, last alloc < 256 MiB

claim: disk cap: the /work tmpfs is 16 MiB (ENOSPC), one file is capped at 8 MiB (EFBIG), /dev/shm is read-only
expected: disk.error=ENOSPC with written <= 16 MiB; fsize.error=EFBIG; shm.error=EROFS

claim: inode exhaustion of /work is bounded (podman cannot set nr_inodes; the 256 MiB memory cap is the real bound)
expected: 60k empty files either hit ENOSPC or complete without killing the supervisor/host

claim: output cap: an unbounded stdout+stderr flood is cut by the supervisor (kept 32 KiB/stream, killed past 8x)
expected: reason=output_flood, kept <= 32 KiB per stream, killed within 2 s, runner stdout stays 1 line

claim: wall-time cap: busy loop killed at the 2.0 s per-case limit and nothing survives
expected: reason=timeout, 2.0 s <= ms < 2.5 s, kill_ms < 250

claim: a sleeping program is also killed at the wall limit
expected: reason=timeout

claim: CPU cap (cpus=1): 4 spinning processes for 1.5 s wall consume ~1.5 CPU-s, not 6
expected: cgroup CPU usage <= 2.2 s (4x1.5 = 6.0 s uncapped)

claim: runner API requires the per-service secret
expected: no secret -> 401; wrong secret -> 401

claim: callers cannot choose mounts, network, image, limits, caps or sockets: every such field is rejected before any container starts
expected: all 400 unknown_fields:<field>

claim: only the learner-code profile is enabled; other §9.4 profiles and oversized submissions are rejected
expected: agent-job -> 400 profile_not_enabled; 70 KB submission -> 413

claim: every job spec is logged and rejected specs are counted (alert hook); the logged podman argv has no socket/volume/privileged
expected: policy rejects == 11, unauthorized == 2, REJECTED log lines == 13, logged argv contains --network none and none of the forbidden flags

claim: a correct Python submission passes the practice tests; a wrong one fails with per-test feedback
expected: correct -> passed (3/3), wrong -> failed (0/3)
actual: correct=passed [True, True, True] wrong=failed [False, False, False]

claim: end-to-end latency of a 3-case run (container create+start+run+teardown), 20 sequential runs
expected: recorded (no threshold)

claim: no containers or supervisor processes are left behind by the suite
expected: none
